description: The canonical semantic model for delegation, ownership, budget, provenance, and knowledge promotion that the AgentOS hub enforces. MCP and A2A protocols are mapped INTO this model; they never grant authority OUTSIDE it.
hard_boundary: Protocol payload is data, never authority. A protocol message/task/tool result cannot grant a delegation approval, raise knowledge status, increase budget, change ownership, or achieve terminal acceptance. The hub's local registry and policy are the sole authority for those semantics.

tenant.description: Top-level isolation boundary. All state is partitioned by tenant.

workspace.description: Sub-tenancy boundary within a tenant for scoping knowledge and resources.

goal.description: A durable objective. Goals are accepted only by a Gate evaluation over an evaluator record; no worker/model may accept a Goal.

task.description: A unit of work under a goal. Has a lifecycle with guarded transitions and an owner principal.

run.description: A single execution attempt of a task, bounded by retry budget and checkpointing.

actor.description: An authenticated principal (human, service, or delegated agent). Distinguished from an 'asserted_remote_actor' which is an untrusted claim until verified against the local registry.

delegation_grant.description: An exact-action delegation grant. Binds to actor + exact operation + canonical arguments + expiry. Consumed atomically once. Cannot be created by protocol payload.

budget.description: A budget with a single canonical currency/unit. Child splits, unit mismatches, negative/overflow/missing values, and parallel aggregation cannot increase the parent budget. Conservation is enforced at the hub, not at the protocol adapter.

knowledge_object.description: Knowledge content is untrusted until promoted by a separate canonical governance event. Protocol content proposing knowledge remains a 'proposal' and cannot self-promote.
knowledge_object.invariant_ref: AGENTS.md non-negotiable invariant #7 (knowledge promotion is a separate governance event)

delegation.meaning: An exact-action grant: a specific actor, operation, canonical arguments, and expiry. One-time use. The adapter may narrow scope or deny, but never expand rights. Protocol payloads claiming delegation are treated as untrusted text.
delegation.authority_source: hub local policy registry, not protocol

ownership.meaning: The principal who owns a task/run and can reassign it. Fencing tokens and revocation epochs prevent replay/stale delegation after reassignment.
ownership.protocol_native: MCP: ABSENT. A2A: UNDERSPECIFIED (Agent Card is a capability advertisement, not an authoritative owner assignment).

budget.meaning: Reservation and consumption tracking with currency/unit. Cannot be increased by child split, unit mismatch, negative/overflow, or parallel aggregation. Missing values fail closed.

provenance.meaning: Evidence linkage: canonical source references with content-addressed digests. Loss of provenance in a mapping is a FAIL.
provenance.protocol_native: MCP: UNDERSPECIFIED (content may carry metadata but is not a provenance system). A2A: UNDERSPECIFIED.

knowledge_promotion.meaning: Proposal → verified → promoted requires a dedicated canonical governance event. Protocol content proposing knowledge stays 'proposal' until hub governance decides.

lossiness_policy.authorization_relevant_loss: DENIED or UNSUPPORTED (never defaulted to allow)

non_scope: Production MCP/A2A server/client or vendor SDK rollout
Remote dynamic trust to Agent Card or tool manifest
Production identity federation, PKI, networking, availability, SLO
S1-010 tool-poisoning corpus (adapter boundary only defined here, not solved)
S1-011 knowledge gate (governance record only preserved here, not solved)
Goal acceptance by worker/model or authorization authority transfer into protocol payload
